result.title: SP-DocReader: Difference-Aware Self-Play for Precise Document OCR
result.summary: Accurate page transcription remains difficult for vision language models under limited input and training budgets. We present SP-DocReader, a self-play framework for optical character recognition (OCR) that targets residual errors after supervised fine-tuning. Reading Discrepancy Masking aligns reference and generated model tokens through a longest common subsequence, then scores unmatched positions with their full conditioning prefixes. Focused Fidelity Loss adds direct negative log-likelihood supervision at unmatched ground-truth positions. Only the OCR module is trained, while the backbone remains frozen. We derive the combined gradient to distinguish relative score optimization from direct supervision. Compared with SFT-2, SP-DR-3 reduces Vary-600K character error rate on both backbones. On Qwen3-VL-4B, it reduces character error rate by approximately 54 percent and improves DocVQA Average Normalized Levenshtein Similarity (ANLS) by 3.7 points. These results show the value of focusing self-play training on the discrepancies that remain after supervised fine-tuning.

AI.brief_summary: SP-DocReader 提出面向文档 OCR 的自对弈训练框架：用最长公共子序列对齐参考与生成 token，对未匹配位置施加直接负对数似然监督，并推导梯度以区分相对评分优化与直接监督，从而削减 SFT 后的残余识别错误。
AI.relevance_reason: 该方法「只在差异位置施加直接监督、并区分相对评分与直接监督梯度」的设计，可能为 latent 推理轨迹中监督施加位置与贡献分配的取舍提供可供核查的线索，但原文面向 OCR 转录而非多模态推理。
